description: Breitbandatlas - Daten zur Breitband und Mobilfunkversorgung is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by wms.prod.k8s.gigabit-grundbuch.online. The WMS contains the data of the broadband atlas in individual map layers. These are Germany-wide datasets. A distinction is made between broadband data and mobile data. The availability can be displayed up to the municipal level. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Broadband Atlas - Data on Broadband and Mobile Networking" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include opendata, gdiby, LTE, Mobilfunk, Breitband, Autonom. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2022-12-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
